benchmarkDetail.summary: This page shows the currently stored benchmark dataset for one algorithm. It exposes raw timing data by language and input size, plus any benchmark snapshot metadata published by CI.
benchmarkDetail.compositeDescription: A normalized summary of the current stored benchmark profile for this algorithm.
benchmarkDetail.resultsDescription: This algorithm page shows the stored benchmark timings across all supported languages and input sizes.
benchmarkDetail.selectedRankingDescription: Current ranking on the benchmark overview is based on raw time for {{language}} at {{size}} size. Lower is better.
benchmarkDetail.noPoints: No points or composite score are available yet.
benchmarkDetail.profileDescription: Each dimension shows the stored workload score for the selected language, together with the raw timings for small, medium, and large inputs.
benchmarkDetail.dataDescription: This is the benchmark metadata currently published for this algorithm entry.
benchmarkDetail.snapshotDescription: When CI publishes benchmark metadata, it is shown here together with the harness policy used for the run.
benchmarkDetail.scoreDescription: The schema already reserves space for future score fields, but this benchmark currently ranks by raw time only.
benchmarkDetail.futureDescription: These fields are placeholders for future workload profiles and tiered benchmark views.

about.title: Built for people who learn by watching code move.
about.description: Sort Playground is an open sorting lab for classic algorithms, weird experiments, and meme sorts.
about.staticDescription: Open the page, run a sort, and export the result. The tool stays fast, portable, and easy to share.
about.conceptBody: A playground where algorithms are understandable as motion, data, and code.
about.designBody: Calm glass surfaces, compact developer metadata, and exportable visual artifacts.
about.buildBody: Fast pages, clear steps, browser exports, and a contribution flow that stays simple.

benchmark.title: Sort Benchmark
benchmark.subtitle: A reproducible benchmark for sorting algorithms across languages.

intro.body1: This benchmark focuses on consistent, reproducible measurements of sorting algorithms.
intro.body2: It is designed to compare behavior across different implementations and languages under controlled conditions.

points.datasets: Fixed datasets are used so every implementation runs against the same inputs.
points.sizes: Multiple input sizes are included to reflect small, medium, and large sorting workloads.
points.repeats: Warm-up passes and repeated runs are used to reduce one-off timing noise.
points.environment: Execution happens in a controlled environment so published results stay comparable.

scope.label: Scope
scope.title: What is covered
scope.description: The benchmark is intended for direct, cross-language comparison of supported sorting implementations.
